title: Loading two ShaderMaterial resources with `shader_type particles` shaders concurrently makes both shaders fail to compile
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.8.dev2.official [7220d456d], v4.7.1.stable.official [a13da4feb], v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4]

### System information

Godot v4.6.3.stable - macOS Sequoia (15.7.5) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Mobile) - integrated Apple M2 Max (Apple8) - Apple M2 Max (12 threads) - 64.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

Two `ShaderMaterial` resources, each referencing its own `shader_type particles` shader, are requested with `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request()` so that the two loads overlap. Each resource is only retrieved once `load_threaded_get_status()` no longer reports `THREAD_LOAD_IN_PROGRESS`. Both shaders then fail to compile. Each of them compiles without errors when loaded on its own.

```
round 0 done
--res://shader_a.gdshader--
--res://shader_b.gdshader--
E   1-> shader_type particles;
E   1-> shader_type particles;
    2 | 
    2 | 
    3 | void start() {
    3 | void start() {
round 1 done
--res://shader_b.gdshader--
--res://shader_a.gdshader--
E   1-> shader_type particles;
E   1-> shader_type particles;
    2 | 
    2 | 
    3 | void start() {
    3 | void start() {
--- Debugging process stopped ---
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the MRP and run it.
2. Error messages are printed.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[concurrent-shader-compile-corruption-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30689904/concurrent-shader-compile-corruption-mrp.zip)
